run_visualcheck_main: run the visualcheck module to decode word frequency or phonetic voicing from brain recordings
preprocess_recordings: preprocess brain recordings by filtering, decimating, and creating MNE epochs with baseline correction
decod_word_frequency: decode word frequency or phoneme voicing from MNE epochs using Ridge regression with cross validation
get_subjects_from_dataset: get subjects grouped by UID from a dataset by iterating recordings and filtering by subject
fast_percentile_approximation: compute an approximate percentile of a numpy array using random sampling for speed
